project_title: Scalable Vector Ingestion & Batch Search Pipeline

milestones.name: Batch Document Processing Pipeline
milestones.why_added: Enables high-throughput document transformation and memory-efficient batch ingestion.
milestones.tradeoff: Lacks real-time indexing capabilities and requires bounded memory buffers.
milestones.verification_metric: Processes 50k documents per minute with RAM usage bounded under 1 GB.

milestones.name: Partitioned Vector Database Ingestion
milestones.why_added: Provides persistent vector storage with partitioned payload filtering.
milestones.tradeoff: Disk write amplification during large batch indexing slows concurrent queries.
milestones.verification_metric: Upserts 10k vectors in under 15 seconds over gRPC.

milestones.name: Asynchronous ETL Task Queue
milestones.why_added: Decouples slow document embedding workers from user-facing API request cycles.
milestones.tradeoff: Introduces eventual consistency and requires dead-letter queue monitoring.
milestones.verification_metric: Zero task drops across 10,000 asynchronous ingestion jobs.

milestones.name: Automated Data Quality & Drift Validation
milestones.why_added: Asserts schema integrity and vector dimensionality before writing to production indices.
milestones.tradeoff: Adds 5% compute overhead to the ingestion pipeline execution time.
milestones.verification_metric: Catches 100% of malformed payloads before database persistence.

milestones.name: Continuous Pipeline CI/CD & Infrastructure as Code
milestones.why_added: Automates regression testing, image vulnerability scanning, and infrastructure setup.
milestones.tradeoff: Increases pipeline configuration maintenance and CI run-minute consumption.
milestones.verification_metric: Automated build and test suite completes in under 5 minutes.
